4XX.description: an isError result (X-Star set) or a bad_args refusal

admit.description: Run the gated write: permit first, then capture only if permitted. Name decision_id to hold the write to that decision's standing autonomy grant. An assertIfAbsent op asserts a literal only if the subject holds none under the predicate, answering asserted and the standing value; the rest of its batch rides with it or not at all. expect states preconditions on slots (absent, held or rev): the batch commits only if every one holds, else it is refused conflict and nothing is written.

decision_id.description: Holds the write to this decision's standing autonomy grant.

expect.description: Slot preconditions: the batch commits only if every one holds.

items.description: One precondition: a slot and exactly one of absent, held or rev.

absent.description: true: the slot holds no current fact.

g.description: The graph; empty means every graph.

held.description: The slot's current object set, exactly.

items.description: One held object: a literal (with dtype, lang), a node, or a blob.

rev.description: The slot's revision; 0 means never written.

now.description: The logical clock the grant is read at; 0 reads no votes.

dtype.description: Edge ops: types the to_literal; instant stores decimal epoch-microseconds, wallclock a naive date-time, any other word rides verbatim. Legal only beside a to_literal.

from_id.description: Edge ops: the subject, a node id or {"$mint": i} for the i-th createNode.

graph.description: removeEdge: pins the retraction to this graph's hex; other ops ignore it.

id.description: relabel, close: the node's id; a close needs a live 64-hex one.

kind.description: createNode: the kind to mint, when node_type is absent.

mode.description: close: the finality mode, empty is done; refused on any op when not one of these.

naive.description: Edge ops: what an instant with no offset means, one of refuse, utc, eastern; legal only with dtype instant, default refuse.

node_type.description: createNode: the kind to mint; falls back to kind.

op.description: The op kind; assertIfAbsent is admit's alone, at most one per batch.

to_blob.description: Edge ops: a blob id, a decimal string or a positive integer.

to_literal.description: Edge ops: a literal object; null when the object is a node.

to_node.description: Edge ops: a node id or {"$mint": i}; null when the object is a literal.

scope.description: The graph the facts live in.

admit.name: admit

outputSchema.title: themis_admit — the answer
outputSchema.description: A write batch put through the gate. admitted=false with tx null when the gate refused it; minted lists the hex ids the batch created. A refusal is NOT described here: it is an isError result {code, detail} (refusal.schema.json), and its code is in contracts/refusal-codes.toml. An assertIfAbsent batch (one op, alone) also answers asserted and standing.

items.description: One write-gate violation; predicate is null when none applies.

asserted.description: assertIfAbsent only: true when this call asserted the literal, false when the slot already held one (or the gate refused).

standing.description: assertIfAbsent only: the value the slot holds after the call: the one just asserted, or the one already held. Absent when the gate refused.
